title: Execution
description: One bounded run of an agent. Executions are journaled; terminal records are never mutated; retries create new records referencing the original (ADR 0007). At most one execution runs per durable agent at a time (ADR 0009).

ref.description: Id of the inbox item, wait condition, or prior execution that triggered this run.

retry_of.description: Execution id this run retries, if any.

reason.description: e.g. runtime_error, orphaned, budget_exhausted, result_invalid, timeout

context_manifest.description: Refs (memory ids, event ids, artifact ids) used to build this execution's context; audit trail for context reconstruction.
